Q: I'm burning up, and I can't catch my breath. I'm sweating and shivering, and I'm so tired. My heart is racing, and I'm coughing up brown stuff.
A: pneumonia

[2]
Q: I have a fever and a headache. I have sores near my nose and rashes on my neck. I'm really struggling right now.
A: impetigo

[3]
Q: i have been having high fever since past few days , saliva also became thick , dry cough , weakness also seen
A: bronchial asthma

[4]
Q: I've been feeling really sick lately. I've been having a lot of nausea and I feel really uneasy. I've also noticed some rashes on my arms and legs. I've lost my appetite and I feel exhausted every day.
A: chicken pox

[5]
Q: I have a high fever, chills, nausea, and severe itching. I also have a headache and am sweating a lot. I have muscle aches and nausea.
A: malaria

[6]
Q: I've been coughing a lot, and I feel cold and shivery. My nose is stuffy, and I feel pressure in my face. I have a lot of phlegm, and coughing hurts my chest. I can't smell anything, and my muscles hurt.
A: common cold

[7]
Q: I have small dents in my nails and they are often inflamed and tender to the touch. I also have minor rashes on my arms.
A: psoriasis

[8]
Q: I have rashes that sometimes peel off my skin. This makes me more likely to get infections. My hands shake and I sometimes have tremors.
A: drug reaction

[9]
Q: I have a rash all over my body. It's red and swollen, and it's worse in some places, like my arms and legs. I also don't feel like eating.
A: dengue

[10]
Q: I have a rash on my arms and neck that itches like crazy. I've been feeling really uncomfortable all day.
A: chicken pox

side_calls.reasoning_content:
The retrieved examples show:
[5] malaria: high fever, chills, nausea, severe itching, headache, sweating, muscle aches. (No rash mentioned here, but has chills/fever).
[9] dengue: rash all over body, red and swollen, worse in arms and legs, loss of appetite.
[10] chicken pox: rash on arms and neck that itches like crazy.

Wait, the patient's symptoms are: "I've been shivering and shivering and I feel cold. My fever is really high. I have rashes on my arms and red patches on my neck."
This matches Dengue very well. High fever + shivering/chills + rash on arms and neck.
Let's check if there's an exact match for "shivering" and "rashes on arms".
Another possibility: Malaria has "chills" and "high fever", but rash is not typical.
Dengue typically presents with sudden onset of high fever, chills/shivering, and a characteristic rash (often starting on the trunk or extremities like arms, and can spread to the neck/face).

Let's look at reference [9]: "I have a rash all over my body. It's red and swollen, and it's worse in some places, like the arms and legs. I also don't feel like eating." -> dengue.
Reference [4]: "I've been feeling really sick lately. I've been having a lot of nausea and I feel really uneasy. I've also noticed some rashes on my arms and legs. I've lost my appetite and I feel exhausted every day." -> chicken pox.

What about "shivering and shivering and I feel cold. My fever is really high."? This strongly points to the febrile phase of Dengue or Malaria. Since rash is prominent (arms and neck), Dengue is the best fit.

Let's consider "dengue" vs "malaria". Malaria usually doesn't have rashes. Dengue classically has a rash. The prompt explicitly mentions rashes on arms and red patches on neck. So dengue is highly likely.

Let's do one more search to be sure.
